sections.extract: Poincaré Disc Model Danijela Simié Filip Marié Pierre Boutry February 6, 2026 Abstract We describe formalization of the Poincaré disc model of hyperbolic geometry within the Isabelle/HOL proof assistant. The model is defined within the extended complex plane (one dimensional complex projective space CP’), formalized in the AFP entry “Complex Geometry” [6]. sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: Poincaré disc is a model of hyperbolic geometry. That fact has been a mathematical folklore for more than 100 years. However, up to the best of our knowledge, fully precise, formal proofs of this fact are lacking. In this paper we present a formalization of the Poincaré disc model in Isabelle/HOL, introduce its basic notions (h-points, h-lines, h-congruence, h-isometries, h-betweenness) and prove that it models
